subject: a very tall, lean 19th-century American man with long arms, coarse black hair, deep-set grey eyes and a long angular face, wearing a plain black frock coat, white shirt and black tie

panels.01-firelight: a tall thin barefoot frontier boy of about ten in homespun linen shirt and deerskin trousers lying on the plank floor of a rough Indiana log cabin around 1818, reading a worn borrowed book by the light of a stone fireplace, an axe leaning by the door, snow at the small window, quiet focus
panels.02-flatboat: two young frontiersmen in homespun shirts and broad hats steering a long wooden flatboat loaded with barrels and sacks down the wide Mississippi River in 1828, one very tall and lanky leaning on a long steering oar, forested riverbanks, distant steamboat smoke, morning light
panels.03-surveyor: a very tall lanky clean-shaven young man of 24 in a plain linen shirt and work trousers using a surveyor's compass on a tripod and a long iron chain at the edge of an Illinois prairie and woodland in 1833, a borrowed surveying book open on a stump, a helper holding the chain, wide sky
panels.04-lawbooks: a very tall lanky clean-shaven young man of 25 with coarse black hair sitting on a wooden counter in a small 1830s frontier village store, absorbed in reading a thick leather-bound law book, more borrowed law books stacked beside him, shelves of cloth and barrels, lamplight, New Salem Illinois, lit only by a tallow candle and daylight from a small window, no electric lights, no light bulbs, 1830s frontier store
panels.05-debates: {S} clean-shaven at age 49, standing tall on an outdoor wooden platform in an Illinois town square in 1858 debating a short, broad-shouldered man in a dark coat, a huge attentive crowd of men and women in 1850s clothing, bunting on the platform, reporters writing at a table below, afternoon light
panels.06-cooperunion: {S} clean-shaven at age 51 in a new black suit at a lectern in a large arched basement hall in New York in 1860, holding pages of a long handwritten speech, rows of attentive men in 1860s coats in gaslight, columns, serious and confident
panels.07-gettysburg: {S} at age 54 with a short dark beard, standing bareheaded on a crowded wooden platform on a hillside at a new soldiers' cemetery in Pennsylvania in November 1863, holding a single page, a large quiet crowd of civilians and soldiers in 1860s clothing, rows of simple fresh grave markers and bare autumn trees, flags, solemn and dignified, no weapons
panels.08-malice: {S}, tall and gaunt with a chin beard and no moustache, in a black 1860s frock coat, high white collar and black silk bow cravat, reading his short speech from a single printed sheet on a wooden platform at the US Capitol in March 1865, a large crowd in 1860s coats and bonnets below, grey sky, solemn, no modern necktie
